semantics.clock: All sequential updates on rising clk edge
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset overrides inputs and returns to A, clears partial group and z
semantics.initialization: FSM assumed in A; implementation requires synchronous reset to establish hardware state; no power-up initial construct
semantics.state_A: Remain while s=0; when s=1 enter sampling mode. w on that transition edge is not sampled. z=0 in A
semantics.sampling: After leaving A sample w on each of next three rising edges. Continue disjoint three-edge groups indefinitely; ignore s outside A
semantics.output: After third sample edge z equals 1 iff that group contains exactly two ones, held for following clock cycle. At next edge z clears while first sample of next group is accepted. No idle gap between groups

numeric.count: Number of ones in group ranges 0..3, exact integer arithmetic with two-bit storage; no rounding or saturation
numeric.phase: Three sampling positions plus reset/idle state; no extra protocol

verification.oracle: Independent behavioral list of three sampled w bits, count ones and check output after every edge; model activation separately
directed: reset at each sample position and when z=1
reset assertion between edges leaves outputs unchanged until rising edge
verification.random: Seeded binary inputs and synchronous resets; compare every cycle
verification.tools: Icarus v12 -g2012 explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and run timeouts

specification_ambiguities: Diagram mentioned in text is absent. Timing interpreted from next three clock cycles and following clock cycle: result visible immediately after third sampling edge for the ensuing cycle.
No physical power-up mechanism specified; synchronous reset establishes assumed A state.
